max_devices.description: Maximum number of fingerprint devices that can be enrolled per user at the same time. Set to 0 for unlimited.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (1=error, 2=info, 3=debug). Use 'info' or 'debug' for troubleshooting.

data_store.description: Absolute or relative path for storing fingerprint templates. If empty, uses the default XDG-based location.

drivers.description: Ordered list of fingerprint drivers to use (e.g., 'libfprint-2-tod1-goodix', 'libfprint-2-tod1-vfs0090'). Leave empty to let fprintd auto-select the best available driver.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for device enumeration before timing out.
